description: Only the 'Common across DC' cases need a human: https://hello.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DCCore/pages/7424609152/Human+review+required+-+Enable+semi-automated+FE+Renovate+upgrades. Renovate's automerge would not stop the automerger, it only honours the commit marker. Bitbucket Cloud ignores code owners on API-created PRs, so Renovate has to add them; the API accepts only @{uuid}.

packageRules.description: Mark upgrades for automatic merge by default without requesting reviewers. Preserve the uppercase [NO-CODEOWNERS] title marker because the codeowners PR Forge app matches it case-sensitively.
Require manual merge for minor and major upgrades from 0.x because these versions do not guarantee API stability.
